It prevented every change in routine.
It allowed a complete change of habits and distance from conventions.
It proved that philology was unrelated to languages.
questions.promptZh: 长期疾病在叙述中提供什么机会？
optionsZh: 使他于1876年接受任命。
阻止一切习惯变化。
让他彻底改变习惯、脱离惯常规范。
证明语文学不研究语言。
analyses: A 任命是1869年，1876年因病请假。
B gave...change habits 与此相反。
C 末两句直接支持；个人传记不作所有患者因果保证。
D 括号明确语文学研究语言历史。

Only illness can ever change perspectives.
Nietzsche’s account is presented as a controlled experiment.

questions.translation: “犹太人被要求佩戴大卫之星，并遵守下午六点宵禁。我去和一位基督徒朋友玩，逗留太晚。我把棕色毛衣翻面，走几个街区回家。”

evidence.quote: Jews were required to wear the Star of David and to obey a 6 p.m. curfew. I had gone to play with a Christian friend and had stayed too late. I turned my brown sweater inside out to walk the few blocks home.
